quote: indicated for the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of atopic dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient fluticasone propionate lotion is indicated for atopic dermatitis (synonym of atopic eczema).

quote: Acute rheumatic carditis
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone lists acute rheumatic carditis, a form of inflammation of the heart layers.

quote: Temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: Single-ingredient diphenhydramine OTC labels cover hay fever (allergic rhinitis) symptoms.

quote: Herpes zoster ophthalmicus
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone lists herpes zoster ophthalmicus, a subtype of herpes zoster.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic
note: Single-ingredient buprenorphine is indicated for severe pain generally, of which spinal pain is a specific instance; combination (buprenorphine/naloxone) text is not involved.

quote: relieves heartburn associated with acid indigestion and sour stomach
note: Single-ingredient famotidine OTC labels explicitly name acid indigestion.

quote: symptomatic sarcoidosis
note: Single-ingredient triamcinolone injectable lists symptomatic sarcoidosis.

quote: Glimepiride tablets are indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: Single-ingredient glimepiride label is indicated for type 2 diabetes.

quote: keratosis palmaris, keratoderma
note: Single-ingredient urea labels list keratoderma and keratosis palmaris among hyperkeratotic conditions treated.

quote: indicated for the management of patients with chronic stable angina (effort-associated angina)
note: Single-ingredient nicardipine is indicated for effort-associated (exercise-induced) angina.

quote: Atrial fibrillation with embolization
note: Single-ingredient heparin sodium label lists atrial fibrillation with embolization.

quote: indicated for use in adults for the management of moderate-to-severe pain
note: Single-ingredient meloxicam (QAMZOVA/XIFYRM) covers moderate-to-severe pain generally, so vulvovaginal pain is at most a site-specific instance; combination labels (ZYNRELEF postsurgical, SYMBRAVO migraine) are irrelevant, though the support is generic.

quote: HEMADY is indicated in combination with other anti-myeloma products for the treatment of adults with multiple myeloma (MM)
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone (HEMADY) is indicated for multiple myeloma.

quote: helpspreventanother heart attack or stroke
note: Single-ingredient aspirin label covers secondary stroke prevention, independent of the aspirin/dipyridamole combination.

quote: the premenstrual and menstrual periods (dysmenorrhea)
note: Single-ingredient acetaminophen OTC labels name dysmenorrhea.

quote: perennial or seasonal allergic rhinitis
note: Only on the betamethasone sodium phosphate/betamethasone acetate injectable, whose 'combination' consists solely of two betamethasone salts, so the indication is attributable to betamethasone itself.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Single-ingredient ipratropium HFA label names chronic bronchitis.

quote: Chorioretinitis
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone lists chorioretinitis among ophthalmic diseases.

quote: Acute rheumatic carditis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone lists acute rheumatic carditis.

quote: In anaphylaxis as an adjunct to epinephrine and other standard measures after the acute symptoms have been controlled
note: Single-ingredient promethazine is indicated adjunctively in anaphylaxis.

quote: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone lists idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a subtype of pulmonary fibrosis.

quote: Treatment of Chronic Rhinosinusitis with Nasal Polyps
note: Single-ingredient mometasone nasal spray is indicated for chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps.

quote: Narcolepsy
note: Single-ingredient amphetamine label lists narcolepsy (mixed amphetamine salts combination also has it, but those are all amphetamine salts).

quote: indicated for the relief of bronchospasm in patients 2 to 12 years of age with asthma
note: Single-ingredient albuterol is indicated for bronchospasm in asthma.

quote: To tide the patient over a critical period of the disease in regional enteritis (systemic therapy) and ulcerative colitis
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone lists ulcerative colitis.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin
note: Single-ingredient erythromycin label lists diphtheria.

quote: treatment of inflammatory papules and pustules of rosacea
note: Single-ingredient topical metronidazole explicitly treats pustules of rosacea.

quote: intended for topical application in the following scaling dermatoses: seborrheic dermatitis and seborrhea sicca (dandruff)
note: Single-ingredient sodium sulfacetamide wash is indicated for seborrheic dermatitis.

quote: dermatomyositis (polymyositis)
note: Single-ingredient prednisone lists dermatomyositis.

quote: Helicobacter pylori eradication in adult patients to reduce the risk of duodenal ulcer recurrence
note: Single-ingredient omeprazole labels cover duodenal ulcer (including active duodenal ulcer treatment).

quote: indicated in the treatment of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with ocular hypertension or open-angle glaucoma
note: Single-ingredient brinzolamide and EMA Azopt text both name ocular hypertension.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: Single-ingredient pseudoephedrine OTC labels name nasal congestion.

quote: Exfoliative dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone lists exfoliative dermatitis under dermatologic diseases.

quote: Intra-abdominal Infections , including peritonitis caused by Escherichia coli, Klebsiella species
note: Single-ingredient aztreonam label names peritonitis.

quote: Acute adrenocortical insufficiency (hydrocortisone or cortisone is the drug of choice
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone lists acute adrenocortical insufficiency.

quote: Uses for temporary relief of mild symptoms of intermittent asthma ■ wheezing
note: Single-ingredient OTC epinephrine inhaler lists wheezing.

quote: Syphilis caused by Treponema pallidum
note: Single-ingredient doxycycline label lists syphilis.

quote: Fluoxetine capsules and Olanzapine in Combination are indicated for the treatment of: Treatment resistant depression
note: Fluoxetine's own label carries TRD for co-use with olanzapine (monotherapy not indicated), and on Symbyax the antidepressant component is fluoxetine, so not a co-ingredient artifact.

quote: Minor pain of arthritis
note: Single-ingredient acetaminophen relieves minor arthritis pain, which covers RA only symptomatically; the support is the same in single and combination text, so this is not a co-ingredient artifact.

quote: other inflammatory conditions of the anorectum, and pruritus ani
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone acetate rectal products name pruritus ani.

quote: contact dermatitis; atopic dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone lists several dermatitis types (contact, atopic, exfoliative, seborrheic).

quote: indicated for the relief of the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis in adults and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older
note: Single-ingredient olopatadine nasal spray is indicated for seasonal allergic rhinitis.

quote: Septicemia, empyema, pneumonia, pericarditis, endocarditis, meningitis
note: Single-ingredient penicillin G label lists pneumonia.

quote: improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: Single-ingredient liraglutide (Victoza) covers type 2 diabetes; XULTOPHY also contains liraglutide's own action, so not a co-ingredient artifact.

quote: Diffuse posterior uveitis and choroiditis
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone lists uveitis among ophthalmic diseases.

quote: indicated in adults for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Single-ingredient IR tramadol covers severe pain generally, including breakthrough pain episodes; it does not rely on tramadol/acetaminophen.

quote: asthma (as distinct from allergic asthma listed above under "Allergic States")
note: Single-ingredient prednisone lists asthma.

quote: Severe seborrheic dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone lists severe seborrheic dermatitis.

quote: indicated as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management
note: Single-ingredient liraglutide (SAXENDA) is indicated for chronic weight management.

note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin is indicated for complicated intra-abdominal infections.
